correctness.rationale: The two independent Markov bridge segments, conditional on the signed interior value, each have the correctly normalized Pitman local-time survival tail; coupling them with two positive exponentials gives strict decreasing regression in the interior modulus. Independently, Gaussian conditional densities give E[L|B_t|]=(sqrt(t)+sqrt(1-t)-1). The two beta/trigonometric integrals, endpoint cases, t=1/2 extremum, L mean sqrt(pi/2), and Fubini for L1 weights are fully established by the proof. The extracted verify.py independently tests 10 Gaussian integrals, 6 tail integrals, 12 conditional coupling inequalities and one weighted integral; finite tests are not claimed to prove the continuum result.

value.rationale: The theorem is a continuum-resolved dependence law for the canonical local-time and displacement observables of a pinned diffusion; it precisely identifies sign, factorized magnitude and unique peak time for all interior t, and resolves arbitrary deterministic nonnegative weighted-absolute-area covariance signs from one kernel. The conditional stochastic-order representation is useful to simulate and understand negative regression, not a cosmetic parameter specialization or a finite-point calculation.
